text: {"lessons":["After buying the five stocks, my account declined and later recovered somewhat; these short-term moves don't show whether my choices were sound or predict future returns.","I should preserve cash and avoid concentrating too much at once, while keeping my ten-year apartment goal and risk tolerance in mind.","I should follow a consistent, evidence-based plan and review it over time rather than react to monthly fluctuations or trade without a clear reason."]}
